reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000625 (the melody read from 000625a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Ludwig von Beethoven's dates (1770–1827) are from our page for the tune HYMN TO JOY (content/hymns/tunes/hymn-to-joy.json); CCEH's page gives none. Alfred Judson's dates (1866–1930) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Judson_Alfred ('Pseudonym. See also Joseph Lincoln Hall, 1866-1930'); https://www.hymnary.org/person/Hall_JLincoln (Hall, J. Lincoln (Joseph Lincoln), 1866-1930). CCEH credits 'arr., Alfred Judson, 1923' on ALSACE; https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n2009021476 knows the name only from Easter classics No. 4, 1916, with no dates. The dates are J. Lincoln Hall's, on Hymnary's word that the name is his pseudonym; CCEH's page gives only the year 1923. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1923, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000625a.nwc).
